```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(totalevalerror)
```

The bundled `arena_pilot` is a subsample of the Chatbot Arena LLM-as-judge Likert pilot (Messing 2026, Section `sec:arena`). Categories are Arena's auto-classification of battle topics (creative_writing, persuasion, coding, factual_qa).

## 1. Load and wrap

```{r load}
data(arena_pilot)
str(arena_pilot)

des <- tee_design(
  arena_pilot,
  outcome     = outcome,
  item        = item_id,
  category    = category,
  prompt      = variant_id,
  judge       = judge_model,
  replicate   = replication,
  scoring     = "likert"
)
```

## 2. Variance decomposition

```{r fit}
fit <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(tee_decompose(des)))
generics::tidy(fit)[, c("tle_label", "variance", "pct_total", "tier")]
```

In the full Arena Likert dataset, judge x item interaction dominates within most categories, but the secondary structure differs (creative_writing has more prompt sensitivity than coding, for example).
